_schema.purpose: Self-contained Jetson TensorRT B/C bundle for LiteUAVDETR, whose model implementation is adapted from https://github.com/Peterande/D-FINE.

fields.tag: unique id; engine + result filename stem
fields.onnx: relative path (under this folder) to the fp32 ONNX exported off-device
fields.source_repo: repo-relative source tree used for export
fields.weights: repo-relative checkpoint path used for export
fields.export_script: repo-relative script that produced the ONNX

_schema.note: ONNX is portable across machines; TensorRT engines are NOT (GPU/CUDA/TRT-version specific) and are built here on the Jetson.
